proposed_comments.body:
### Use the official AltBacktick casing

**Severity:** `low`

The attribution currently spells the referenced project as `AltBackTick`, but the project name is `AltBacktick`. Because the translator comment explicitly tells localizers not to change the product name, this would preserve the wrong casing in localized builds as well.

```suggestion
    <value>Wzhudev's work on AltBacktick</value>
    <comment>Wzhudev is a person's GitHub username and AltBacktick is a product name. Do not localize either name; localize the attribution wording.</comment>
```
